name: Yukishiro Suzuno
source:
Suzuno is a mysterious girl who claims she is a spirit not visible to human eyes. She’s quite childish overall but can be mature at times. Like [url=/c807]Sakurako[/url], she is soft-spoken. She also has a weak body and is clumsy. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flyable_Heart]Wikipedia[/url], [url=http://calamitousintents.wordpress.com/2010/12/11/flyable-heart-review/]Calamitous Intent's review[/url], and [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/24/flyable-heart-review/]Liemyx's review[/url]]
